gp.name: Games Played
gp.tooltip: Total games played in the selected time period

gs.name: Games Started
gs.tooltip: Total games started in the selected time period

pf_pg.name: Personal Fouls Per Game
pf_pg.tooltip: Average personal fouls committed per game

plus_minus_pg.name: Plus-Minus Per Game
plus_minus_pg.tooltip: Average point differential while the player was on court

fgm_pg.name: Field Goals Made Per Game
fgm_pg.tooltip: Average field goals made per game

fga_pg.name: Field Goal Attempts Per Game
fga_pg.tooltip: Average field goals attempted per game

fg_pct.name: Field Goal %
fg_pct.tooltip: Percentage of field goals made (FGM / FGA)

fg3m_pg.name: 3-Pointers Made Per Game
fg3m_pg.tooltip: Average 3-point field goals made per game

fg3a_pg.name: 3-Point Attempts Per Game
fg3a_pg.tooltip: Average 3-point field goals attempted per game

ftm_pg.name: Free Throws Made Per Game
ftm_pg.tooltip: Average free throws made per game

fta_pg.name: Free Throw Attempts Per Game
fta_pg.tooltip: Average free throws attempted per game

ft_pct.name: Free Throw %
ft_pct.tooltip: Percentage of free throw attempts made (FTM / FTA)

oreb_pg.name: Offensive Rebounds Per Game
oreb_pg.tooltip: Average offensive rebounds secured per game

dreb_pg.name: Defensive Rebounds Per Game
dreb_pg.tooltip: Average defensive rebounds secured per game

team_reb_share.name: Team Rebound Share %
team_reb_share.tooltip: Percentage of total team rebounds grabbed by this player across games played: Player Rebounds / Team Rebounds

on_court_reb_pct.name: On-Court Available Rebound %
on_court_reb_pct.tooltip: Percentage of all available rebounds grabbed while on the floor: Player Rebounds / (Team + Opponent Rebounds while on court)

ts_pct.name: True Shooting %
ts_pct.tooltip: Scoring efficiency measure taking 2s, 3s, and FTs into account: PTS / (2 * (FGA + 0.44 * FTA))

efg_pct.name: Effective Field Goal %
efg_pct.tooltip: Field goal percentage adjusted for the extra point value of 3-pointers: (FGM + 0.5 * 3PM) / FGA

usg_pct.name: Usage Rate %
usg_pct.tooltip: Estimate of the percentage of team plays used by a player while on the floor

tov_pct.name: Turnover Rate %
tov_pct.tooltip: Turnovers committed per 100 individual offensive plays used

ast_to_ratio.name: Assist-to-Turnover Ratio
ast_to_ratio.tooltip: Ratio of assists credited to turnovers committed

three_par.name: 3-Point Attempt Rate
three_par.tooltip: Percentage of total field goal attempts that are 3-pointers

ft_rate.name: Free Throw Rate
ft_rate.tooltip: Ratio of free throw attempts to field goal attempts (FTA / FGA)

ppsa.name: Points Per Shot Attempt
ppsa.tooltip: Scoring output generated per field goal attempted (PTS / FGA)

gmsc_avg.name: Average Game Score
gmsc_avg.tooltip: John Hollinger's single-game overall box score efficiency rating

per.name: Player Efficiency Rating (PER)
per.tooltip: Per-minute statistical production rating scaled to a league average of 15.0

bpm.name: Box Plus-Minus (BPM 2.0)
bpm.tooltip: Net points contributed per 100 possessions above a league-average player (+0.0 is league average)

vorp.name: Value Over Replacement Player (VORP)
vorp.tooltip: Estimated cumulative points contributed above a replacement level player (-2.0 BPM)

xefg_pct.name: Expected eFG %
xefg_pct.tooltip: Expected effective FG% based purely on the league-wide difficulty of locations taken

smoe.name: Shot-Making Over Expected (SMOE)
smoe.tooltip: Actual eFG% minus Expected eFG%. Measures finishing ability independent of shot diet

mei.name: Moreyball Efficiency Index
mei.tooltip: Percentage of shot possessions ending in high-efficiency areas (Rim, 3PT, or Free Throw line)

corner3_pct.name: Corner 3PT %
corner3_pct.tooltip: Field goal percentage on 3-point attempts from the left/right corners

corner3_fga_pg.name: Corner 3 Attempts Per Game
corner3_fga_pg.tooltip: Corner 3-point field goal attempts per game

atb3_pct.name: Above-the-Break 3PT %
atb3_pct.tooltip: Field goal percentage on 3-point attempts above the break (wings and top of key)

atb3_fga_pg.name: Above-the-Break 3A Per Game
atb3_fga_pg.tooltip: Above-the-break 3-point field goal attempts per game

ast_fg_pct.name: Assisted FG %
ast_fg_pct.tooltip: Percentage of player's made field goals that were assisted by a teammate

unast_fg_pct.name: Unassisted (Self-Created) FG %
unast_fg_pct.tooltip: Percentage of player's made field goals created independently without an assist

ast_3p_pct.name: Assisted 3PT %
ast_3p_pct.tooltip: Percentage of player's made 3-pointers that were assisted (catch-and-shoot looks)

unast_3p_pct.name: Unassisted 3PT %
unast_3p_pct.tooltip: Percentage of player's made 3-pointers that were unassisted (pull-ups / off the dribble)

rim_fg_pct.name: Rim FG % (0-4 ft)
rim_fg_pct.tooltip: Field goal percentage on attempts within 4 feet of the basket

rim_fga_pg.name: Rim Attempts Per Game
rim_fga_pg.tooltip: Attempts per game within 4 feet of the rim

rim_share.name: Rim Attempt Share %
rim_share.tooltip: Percentage of player's total shots taken within 4 feet of the rim

mid_fg_pct.name: Mid-Range FG % (4-14 ft)
mid_fg_pct.tooltip: Field goal percentage on attempts between 4 and 14 feet

mid_fga_pg.name: Mid-Range Attempts Per Game
mid_fga_pg.tooltip: Attempts per game between 4 and 14 feet

mid_share.name: Mid-Range Attempt Share %
mid_share.tooltip: Percentage of player's total shots taken between 4 and 14 feet

three_fg_pct.name: Perimeter / 3PT FG % (14+ ft)
three_fg_pct.tooltip: Field goal percentage on long-range attempts (14+ feet and 3PT)

three_fga_pg.name: Perimeter Attempts Per Game
three_fga_pg.tooltip: Attempts per game from 14+ feet and 3PT range

three_share.name: Perimeter Attempt Share %
three_share.tooltip: Percentage of player's total shots taken from 14+ feet and 3PT range

pts_created_pg.name: Points Created Per Game
pts_created_pg.tooltip: Points scored by teammates directly off this player's assists per game

prf_pg.name: Points Responsible For (PRF)
prf_pg.tooltip: Direct points scored per game plus points created off assists per game

xprf_pg.name: Expected Points Responsible For (xPRF)
xprf_pg.tooltip: Expected total points generated from volume: (FGA * xFG%) + (3PA * x3P%) + (FTA * xFT%) + Expected Assist Points per game

prfoe_pg.name: Points Responsible For Over Expected (PRFOE)
prfoe_pg.tooltip: Actual PRF/G minus Expected PRF/G. Measures individual scoring & playmaking shot-making talent above opportunity baseline

pct_team_prf.name: % of Team Points Accounted For
pct_team_prf.tooltip: Share of the team's total game scoring directly created by this player

pts_per_ast.name: Points Per Assist
pts_per_ast.tooltip: Average points scored per credited assist

xpts_per_ast.name: Expected Points Per Assist
xpts_per_ast.tooltip: Baseline points expected per assist given the shooting zones of targets

paoe.name: Points Per Assist Over Expected (PAOE)
paoe.tooltip: Points per assist minus expected points per assist (shot-creation quality added)

points_added_pg.name: Points Added Per Game
points_added_pg.tooltip: Net points generated per game above the league baseline across all assisted shots

rim_ast_pct.name: Rim Assist Share %
rim_ast_pct.tooltip: Percentage of player's total assists that set up baskets at the rim (0-4 ft)

three_ast_pct.name: 3-Point Assist Share %
three_ast_pct.tooltip: Percentage of player's total assists that set up 3-point field goals

net_rapm.name: Net RAPM
net_rapm.tooltip: Regularized Adjusted Plus-Minus: Isolated net impact per 100 possessions via 10-man ridge regression

orapm.name: Offensive RAPM
orapm.tooltip: Isolated offensive scoring contribution per 100 possessions above league average

drapm.name: Defensive RAPM
drapm.tooltip: Isolated defensive suppression per 100 possessions (higher = better defense)

team_on_ortg.name: Team On Offensive Rating
team_on_ortg.tooltip: Team points scored per 100 possessions while player is ON the court

team_on_drtg.name: Team On Defensive Rating
team_on_drtg.tooltip: Opponent points scored per 100 possessions while player is ON the court

team_on_net_rtg.name: Team On Net Rating
team_on_net_rtg.tooltip: Team Net Rating (ORtg - DRtg) while player is ON the court

team_off_ortg.name: Team Off Offensive Rating
team_off_ortg.tooltip: Team points scored per 100 possessions while player is OFF the court

team_off_drtg.name: Team Off Defensive Rating
team_off_drtg.tooltip: Opponent points scored per 100 possessions while player is OFF the court

team_off_net_rtg.name: Team Off Net Rating
team_off_net_rtg.tooltip: Team Net Rating (ORtg - DRtg) while player is OFF the court

team_diff_ortg.name: Team Diff Offensive Rating
team_diff_ortg.tooltip: Team Offensive Rating ON minus OFF the court

team_diff_drtg.name: Team Diff Defensive Rating
team_diff_drtg.tooltip: Team Defensive Rating ON minus OFF the court (negative = better defense on-court)

team_diff_net_rtg.name: Team Diff Net Rating
team_diff_net_rtg.tooltip: Team Net Rating ON minus OFF the court (Net On/Off impact)

opp_on_ortg.name: Opponent On Offensive Rating
opp_on_ortg.tooltip: Opponent points scored per 100 possessions while player is ON the court

opp_on_drtg.name: Opponent On Defensive Rating
opp_on_drtg.tooltip: Team points allowed by opponent per 100 possessions while player is ON the court

opp_on_net_rtg.name: Opponent On Net Rating
opp_on_net_rtg.tooltip: Opponent Net Rating while player is ON the court

opp_off_ortg.name: Opponent Off Offensive Rating
opp_off_ortg.tooltip: Opponent points scored per 100 possessions while player is OFF the court

opp_off_drtg.name: Opponent Off Defensive Rating
opp_off_drtg.tooltip: Team points allowed by opponent per 100 possessions while player is OFF the court

opp_off_net_rtg.name: Opponent Off Net Rating
opp_off_net_rtg.tooltip: Opponent Net Rating while player is OFF the court

opp_diff_ortg.name: Opponent Diff Offensive Rating
opp_diff_ortg.tooltip: Opponent Offensive Rating ON minus OFF (negative = suppressed opponent offense)

opp_diff_drtg.name: Opponent Diff Defensive Rating
opp_diff_drtg.tooltip: Opponent Defensive Rating ON minus OFF

opp_diff_net_rtg.name: Opponent Diff Net Rating
opp_diff_net_rtg.tooltip: Opponent Net Rating ON minus OFF the court
